name: 566. A priority-served Gemini image is billed at the priority image token rate (priority image token rate) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-7372. gemini/gemini-2.5-flash-image publishes output_cost_per_image_token 3e-05 and output_cost_per_image_token_priority 5.4e-05 (Vertex gemini-3-pro-image: 1.2e-04 and 2.16e-04). The image response carried no served tier, so a priority-served image billed at the standard image token rate, and the fork dropped the priority rate at sync. Fixture only: each row's fixture model answers generateContent with the tier in usageMetadata.serviceTier, the fixture datasheet carries the live gemini-2.5-flash-image rates, and the row reads the logged cost and service_tier by its request id. Routes: /v1/images/generations (566.1, 566.2), the Gemini-native /genai generateContent (566.3, which also reads serviceTier back off the native response) and /v1/images/edits (566.4). Vertex reuses the same converter; it has no fixture provider (it needs Google OAuth) and is pinned by TestVertexGeminiImageCarriesTheServedTier in core/providers/vertex.
